## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.89% | 1M: +21.18%) while Financials (XLF) in CORRECTION (1W: -1.91% | 1M: +7.45%); VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -21.11%) and mixed sector returns confirm a neutral, mixed market.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -21.11%) ↓ falling and BELOW TREND. Credit mildly improving: HYG (1W: -0.09% | 1M: +2.51%) and LQD (1W: -0.67% | 1M: +1.72%) in CORRECTION → net HYG/LQD ↑ rising. Equities showing strength: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.91% | 1M: +10.86%) but duration signals mixed with TLT in CORRECTION (1W: -0.88% | 1M: +0.60%).

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral: UUP RECOVERY (1W: +0.48% | 1M: -1.29%) and TLT CORRECTION (1W: -0.88% | 1M: +0.60%) — no clear dollar or duration bias.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech/semis leading: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.89% | 1M: +21.18%), SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +38.49%), QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.70% | 1M: +15.76%); Weakness in Healthcare/XLC: XBI CORRECTION (1W: -3.45% | 1M: +7.38%), Healthcare sector 1W: -2.84% | 1M: -1.24% — Style: Growth/Momentum showing relative strength.

**5. US vs Global?**
US and broad EM outperform: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.91% | 1M: +10.86%) and EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +14.73%); China lagging: FXI CORRECTION (1W: -3.21% | 1M: +4.35%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Mixed: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +12.21%) showing crypto appetite, while ARKK CORRECTION (1W: -3.49% | 1M: +13.59%) and IWM CORRECTION (1W: -0.08% | 1M: +12.00%) signal selective speculation and rotation.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Industrial metals and oil bid: CPER CORRECTION (1W: -0.22% | 1M: +10.80%), USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.05% | 1M: +14.89%), BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.88% | 1M: +5.95%); Gold taking profit: GLD CORRECTION (1W: -2.76% | 1M: +7.30%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed: XLE RECOVERY (1W: +3.09% | 1M: -7.72%) with oil ETFs (BNO/USO) ABOVE TREND, while natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -11.40%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Tech/semis (XLK, SOXX, QQQ) show 1W and 1M confirmation ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: multiple CORRECTION signals across IWM, ARKK, SLV, TLT constitute a MAJOR DIVERGENCE — breadth thin, keep stance neutral and selective.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to Growth/Momentum ETFs (XLK (1W: +3.89% | 1M: +21.18%), SOXX (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +38.49%)) and monitor credit (HYG/LQD); reduce exposure to late-cycle or beaten-up cyclicals and speculative small-cap/biotech while breadth remains narrow.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +3.89% | 1M: +21.18%) and SOXX (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +38.49%) if semis momentum continues. BEARISH: XBI (1W: -3.45% | 1M: +7.38%) and Communication group (1W: -5.65% | 1M: -3.84%) if breadth fails to widen.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +12.88% | 1M: +5.95%) / USO (1W: +11.05% | 1M: +14.89%) on oil momentum. BEARISH: UNG (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -11.40%) and GLD (1W: -2.76% | 1M: +7.30%) as risk appetite dictates safe-haven flows.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot), XLK/XLF ratio near 2.0 (growth vs value pivot), Breadth: watch 7/11 (transition to broad risk-on) and 4/11 remaining a guardrail for caution.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, tech/semis strong but overall market breadth thin. XLK, SOXX, QQQ showing relative strength; major 1W vs 1M divergences in IWM/ARKK/TLT are the key risks to monitor.
